limitations: Only finite parameter posets of size at most seven are classified. No statement about larger sizes or full-lattice isomorphism is made. Prior type-lattice and cut-pair facts are not novelty claims. Unindexed historical small-poset tables remain a priority risk.
scientific_integrity: Every claimed new finite classification is covered by exhaustive isomorphism-class generation with two independent exact rank-polynomial evaluators, all six explicit cover-list collision certificates, and a nonprobabilistic canonical isomorphism check. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Sharp seven-point failure of graded singleton-type reconstruction in the generic poset
